The asserted as_of_treatment date 2026-06-30 matches the lake treatment field and point override date.

residual_risks: The treatment derivation records audit_needed and proposed negative events, so downstream use should preserve the caution/limited framing rather than cite Escobedo as an unqualified modern rule.
